A feeders open, GT-MVA and PCS5 out; dual-corded halls stay on cord B (MVB), Aux A lost
genset forms MVA alone (corrected: IT feeders open - the genset carries Other-A)
section 1A fault; all five group transformers re-closed together onto SOFC-2A (fast ATS, simultaneous)
section 1A fault; groups re-closed one at a time (baseline sequence)
genset forms MVA; first PCS transformer (TR_PCS5) energised from the 3 MVA machine alone
black start: PCS5 ramps its own transformer from the 690 V side (soft energisation) — no HV switching step, so no inrush step declared
PCS 1-2 form BESS-1 and the mesh with load breakers open except Other-A (2.5 MW); two SOFC group transformers energised together
